lead_raw_text:
The structure of LaMg14Ti crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all La, Mg, and Ti centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors; Mg environments involve 12 Mg neighbors or mixed Mg with La/Ti neighbors, while La and Ti each have 12 Mg neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal that adjacent Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
